## Claims
- [source-backed] The source conjectures minimality of both generating sets for \(J_{v_{r,s,t,n}}\), and reports verification only for \(r\le4,\ n-r\le5\). [source-2, lines 1495-1502]
- [source-backed] For \(n=4m\), \(r=n-r=2m\), and \(i=j=m\), the source states that \(a=b=m\) and, conditional on that conjecture, \(J_{v_{r,s,t,n}}\) requires \(\binom{2m}{m}\) generators. [source-2, lines 1508-1515]
- [proved] **New conditional consequence.** Assuming the cited minimality conjecture, this family satisfies the explicit nonasymptotic bound
  \[
  g(J_{v_{2m,s,t,4m}})\ge \frac{2^{\,n/2}}{\sqrt n}\qquad(n=4m,\ m\ge1),
  \]
  where \(g(J)\) is the minimum cardinality of a generating set.

## Strategy
Put \(c_m=\binom{2m}{m}/4^m\). Then \(c_1=\frac12\) and
\[
\frac{c_{m+1}}{c_m}=\frac{2m+1}{2m+2}>
\sqrt{\frac{m}{m+1}},
\]
since the difference of squares is \(1/[4(m+1)^2]\). Induction gives
\[
\binom{2m}{m}\ge\frac{4^m}{2\sqrt m}.
\]
For \(n=4m\), the right side equals \(2^{n/2}/\sqrt n\). Combining with the source’s conditional exact generator count proves the stated conditional bound.

The requested target is **established conditionally** on the source’s minimality conjecture.

## Gaps
The minimality conjecture is not proved by the supplied source; it explicitly says a proof of the stronger quotient statement had eluded the authors. [source-2, lines 1547-1552] Thus the lower bound is not unconditional.

## Next
An unconditional bound requires an unconditional proof of the minimality conjecture for this \(n=4m\) family.
